title: Wallet Transactions Response
description: Successful transactions response for the requested wallet type.

data.description: Envelope for the transactions list plus the resolved date range for the current page.

start_date_time.description: Lower bound of the returned range. `null` when unbounded.

end_date_time.description: Upper bound of the returned range. `null` when unbounded.

transactions.description: Transactions on this page, newest first.

items.description: A single wallet transaction. `category` is computed relative to the caller (deposit / withdrawal), and `channel` indicates how the money moved (cashier / payment agent).

category.description: Direction of the transaction relative to the caller.

metadata.description: Transaction metadata. `source_*` and `destination_*` fields are populated per the channel/category matrix. Any metadata field whose value would reference internal cashier plumbing is dropped from the response entirely (the field is absent rather than empty).

transaction_gross_amount.description: Gross amount as a decimal string.

transaction_net_amount.description: Net amount as a decimal string.

transaction_currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code the amounts are denominated in.

source_client_id.description: Owning client of the source wallet. Absent for cashier deposits (the source is the system).

source_wallet_type.description: Wallet type on the source side. Absent for cashier deposits.

destination_client_id.description: Owning client of the destination wallet. Absent for cashier withdrawals.

destination_wallet_type.description: Wallet type on the destination side. Absent for cashier withdrawals.

links.description: Cursor-based pagination links. Each link contains only `page_cursor` — follow it verbatim to fetch the next / previous page. `null` when the corresponding page does not exist (e.g. `next` on the last page).

next.description: URL of the next page, or `null` when there is no next page.

prev.description: URL of the previous page, or `null` when there is no previous page.
